description: Codex usage-limit reset announcements recorded by tokenusage.dev's Reset Alerts from @thsottiaux's public posts on X, grouped by UTC calendar date, newest dates first, with posts within each date newest first (at most 50 announcements in total). Optional month selects a UTC month written YYYY-MM. Dates are UTC; only dates with recorded announcements are returned. Only announcements this monitor recorded from @thsottiaux are shown, at most the 50 newest; this is not a complete history. A date without an entry does not mean no reset was announced. Each item has postId, url, postedAt and resetType. resetType is automatic, banked or both; null means recorded before Reset Alerts recorded reset types. A banked reset grant saves a reset for eligible users to apply later and does not itself refill limits. An announcement may describe a forthcoming event or one already completed; a post is not proof that any account's limit was reset. Open its url for the exact wording and eligibility. Unofficial, not affiliated with OpenAI. Source: https://tokenusage.dev/resets

month.description: An optional UTC calendar month, YYYY-MM. Omit it to return every recorded date in the cached response.

name: get_codex_reset_calendar

coverage.description: What this recorded-announcement calendar covers; missing dates do not establish that no reset was announced.
enum: Only announcements this monitor recorded from @thsottiaux are shown, at most the 50 newest; this is not a complete history. A date without an entry does not mean no reset was announced.

days.description: Only dates with recorded announcements, newest dates first; at most 50 announcements in total.

date.description: The UTC calendar date of postedAt, YYYY-MM-DD.

resets.description: Announcements on this UTC date, in source order, newest first.

postedAt.description: When the post was published, ISO 8601 UTC.

resetType.description: The monitor's classification of the post: automatic is a direct usage-limit reset with no saved reset; banked is a reset grant saved for eligible users to apply later; both announces both types. Both classifier calls must give the same type. Null means recorded before Reset Alerts recorded reset types. This is not proof that any account's limit was reset.

generatedAt.description: When tokenusage.dev read this data, ISO 8601 UTC. The server caches it for up to 15 seconds.

lastPolledAt.description: The monitor's latest successful fetch of @thsottiaux's X timeline, checks that found no new posts included, ISO 8601 UTC; null before the first, or when an older record lacks it. It is not a sign that classification or alert delivery is working.

month.description: The requested UTC month, YYYY-MM; null when no month filter was supplied.

source.description: The fixed credit URL, https://tokenusage.dev/resets. When showing the data to other people, show Data: tokenusage.dev linked to this URL on the same screen or in the same message. Personal use needs no visible credit. API and MCP relays must retain source and pass on this credit condition.
